12mgluu: Lower Hondovalle is your base. Gather by hand, build buildings and let them produce resources on their own: the village works even when the game is closed.
lzt8xz: Each building produces a resource every second. Each copy costs 15% more than the previous one. At 10, 25, 50 and 100 copies, upgrades appear that double production.
1dzw5i2: Elara, Marcus and Vesper remember your choices. Their words change with their faction's reputation, with your name and with what you have become.
10sdjf9: Here you see how much the village produces per minute. Feats, Memories, cards and the state of the Valley multiply production.
136a60b: Dungeons are mirrors of your Burden. Descending costs 1 Supply per floor. What you find goes into the Satchel: it's yours only if you return to the surface. If you fall, you lose three quarters of it. Every 5 floors there's a boss.
z7y1ff: Equipment in 7 slots, with rarities from Common to Ancestral. You can upgrade, salvage, sell and forge. Each level gives a Talent Point for the Paths (Cult, Capital, Farmers, Revolt).
w07brm: Daily chest and missions, the dreams of the Living Save, feats (+2% production each), the bestiary and the chronicle of everything the valley remembers.
1w9rrd6: Tap the water, wait for the bait to sink and tap again at the right moment. Each species you fish up is a memory of the valley: +1% production forever.
1lccnhx: The map is a constellation. Choices light stars; with Insight you can read others. Here you find Promises, Fate Shards, Contracts and the state of the shared valley.
hen7ct: The factions ask for resources. Delivering them raises their reputation, but the rival faction loses a little.
rfp98f: Eight factions, no single karma. Each faction has a rival. The states (Ignored, Tolerated, Trusted, Adored, Feared, Banished, Branded) change prices, dialogue, events and endings.
21hssk: Every 10 minutes the storyteller tells your story: production ×2 for 90 seconds.
ui0t5d: Kael and Lyra follow you into the dungeons. Their trust rises when you protect and collapses when you use them as shields: below 25 they hesitate, at 0 they leave. You can send them on expeditions that last real hours, even with the game closed.
6ta1ge: Dissonance is not just a penalty: you can spend it on powerful but destabilizing actions (Dark Pact, Tactical Betrayal, Supply Pyre). The world notices.
agxkoj: Destiny is traded here: items with a story, Fate Shards and resources. Prices depend on the Market Shadows. Every trade stays in the Ledger of Souls.
1ku2eyv: You can let your hero fight alone: it uses abilities coherent with your Burden, the Echo when it's ready and a potion below the threshold chosen in Options. It never uses Dissonance actions.
13au06e: Every day all the bearers strike the Ash Colossus. You have 3 attempts of 10 rounds: the more damage you deal, the better the rewards.
1s68eva: Relics buy permanent upgrades in the Sanctuary. When you close a Cycle you get an ending, permanent Memories, and your bearer becomes an echo that the next ones will meet.
14f6fef: Your first choice has become a mechanical scar. Every Burden has a weight (light = act first, heavy = hit harder), an advantage, a cost, an Echo and a Shadow.
11oh7bx: Every action has a nature (protection, sacrifice, cruelty, betrayal, silence, faith, blood). In battle a GREEN border marks an action coherent with your Burden: it charges Resonance; with a full bar you unlock the Echo. A RED border marks a contrary action: it builds Dissonance. No choice is wrong: it is simply yours.
frmpvz: Ruthless actions raise Corruption, protective ones lower it. High Corruption: stronger enemies, richer loot and, above 60%, an interface that starts to lie (purify it at the Altar).
tnjma5: Some choices create a Promise with a deadline in expeditions. Kept: Resonance and a Shard. Broken: Dissonance and a Promise Hunter who will look for you in the dungeons.
1qrb84e: After each floor you choose: go deeper (richer, riskier) or go back up to secure the satchel. Without supplies you can pledge future max health: if you return you get half back, if you fall it stays until Elara lifts it.
12qp42s: Choose an ability and then the target. The basic attack gives Focus (◆); strong abilities consume it. Melee attacks hit only the front row. Above each enemy you see their next move (⚠). Potions don't use up your turn.
v5unhk: The valley has a state (Bloom, Quiet, Tension, Corruption, Ash, Eclipse, Rebirth) that changes production, enemies and loot. Buildings, promises, corruption and shards shift it.
1heh7f8: By turning on fullscreen you enter the Rite: +25% Resonance, whispers in the music and hidden choices in events. With the audio on you see the moves of invisible enemies.
